credits.title: Hamka: Awal Mula Vol. 3
credits.overview: Set against the backdrop of West Sumatra, a passionate young rebel clashes with his strict scholar father, prompting a self-funded pilgrimage to Mecca where he discovers his destiny to reform Indonesian Islam and finds the love of his life.

credits.title: Cinta Laki-Laki Biasa
credits.overview: When a woman from a rich family falls for a man with humble roots, parental opposition to their marriage is just the first of several hurdles to come.
